--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Find
lemma findGreatest_mono [DecidablePred Q] (hPQ : ∀ n, P n → Q n) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    Nat.findGreatest P m ≤ Nat.findGreatest Q n :=
  le_trans (Nat.findGreatest_mono_right _ hmn) (findGreatest_mono_left hPQ _)

  ⟨⟨x⟩, Equiv.rfl⟩

theorem sSup_adj {s : Set (SimpleGraph V)} {a b : V} : (sSup s).Adj a b ↔ ∃ G ∈ s, Adj G a b :=
  Iff.rfl

  Stream'.ext fun n => get_unfolds_head_tail n s

--src: Mathlib.Topology.Category.Profinite.Nobeling
include hsC in
theorem span_sum : Set.range (eval C) = Set.range (Sum.elim
    (fun (l : GoodProducts (π C (ord I · < o))) ↦ Products.eval C l.1)
    (fun (l : MaxProducts C ho) ↦ Products.eval C l.1)) := by
  rw [← sum_equiv_comp_eval_eq_elim C hsC ho, Equiv.toFun_as_coe,
    EquivLike.range_comp (e := sum_equiv C hsC ho)]

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Subgraph
theorem neighborSet_subset_of_subgraph {x y : Subgraph G} (h : x ≤ y) (v : V) :
    x.neighborSet v ⊆ y.neighborSet v :=
  fun _ h' ↦ h.2 h'
